_comment: DRAFT (UI-11). A short video from an idea. Uses Google Flow, so it costs credits: the estimate comes from creative-hub's video-plan.mjs (estimator, read-only "estimate" mode, run by the job runner on runs/<slug>/video/plan.json: the shot plan must exist before the job is dispatched, so a dispatch without runDir is refused (no estimate); the number approved is the video credits plus the 25% retake reserve), the card shows it, and you approve that number (D11). Every Flow call must carry max_credits and fit the approved budget; the job runner denies it otherwise. maxCredits is the per-job cap. The daily credit cap in jobrunner.json must be above 0 for this template to run.
title: Short video from an idea
description: Plans and generates a short video from an idea with creative-hub's tools, using Google Flow (credits).
